text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sudden drowsiness detected due to failing operation "sheep count."
choice_data_list: Do you mean counting sheep until you fall asleep?
Do you mean counting sheep until you fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. For some reason, the method my father taught me is not executing effectively.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A sheep does one leg press, and proceeds onto two forward lunges.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Once the sheep completes 21,600 hip extensions, it's time to wake up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, considering the burden on the sheep, perhaps swimming would have been a better choice of exercise.
In her own way, she seems genuinely concerned about her inability to sleep.
